name: Sofía Reyes
bio: Ran a record shop for eleven years before Kraft. Believes a playlist should end somewhere different from where it started.

notes.note: Records that sound like the last hour of light. I sequence this one backwards, brightest last.
I've been building this one since we launched. It is the closest thing Kraft has to a house style: tape hiss, room mics, and nothing that sounds finished.
Folk that isn't precious about it. Half of these were recorded outdoors and you can hear a dog somewhere.
My city the way it sounds from a rooftop in Roma Norte. Antonella Iriarte opens it because she is the reason I moved back.
